rows: EFRIS APP (khusimu ye mukhono, Mobile Smartphones)

Bukula “app” khukwama mu AppStore namwe Play Store, ukire khusimu yowo. Rengekha app ni bibindu namwe Kimilimo ari tandikha khukaba               e-invoices.  Irambila khu internet, nenga inyala yarambira khubusa khumala tsinakhu tsirano.

EFD shiba shisuma shifiiti shishangu shirambisibwa mukhukulisa. Khali ni ikhola ye khukulisa “Point of Sale system” (POS)  ni ikhola inyalisa khulindakhukulisa  “virtual Sales Data Controller” (SDC)  bibigatta ne byarusa  e-receipts ni e-invoices. Khali ni shifo shekhukhebulila isi biandikho bibikhibwa mu URA nga ingulana yawele khukholekha. Basubuuzi basubilwa khukula kha EFD.
Computer yekhumeza (khusaba whomukuli ) Ingeli ye kamakesi:

Can be installed on your preferred device like Inya yarebwa khu byuma byesi ulondelewo nga desktop computers, laptops, oba tablets. Shisanila ingulaana ili akarikari Suitable for moderate sales. Kyamise khu URA website https://ura.go.ug/en/efris/efris-login/ asi a e-invoicing downloads lukoye lwa EFRIS (IFRIS link).  Irambila khu internet, nenga inyala yarambira khubusa khumala tsinakhu tsirano.

Ukitabulakho khubirira khu http://ura.go.ug khukaba e-receipts ni    e-invoices nga umiina lukoye lwa EFRIS  khu URA portal. web portal option ino iliwo lwe bakulaani babakhali ni inngulaana yebibyuma tawe, babali ni ingulaana ili asi e kimilundi 100 buli lunakhu, ni khukulisa asi a UGX 2 billion.
Busubuuzi buuli ni ikhola ye khubala iyawangibwa mu Computer (Computerized Accounting Systems)

A trader’s sales system is integratedIkhola yomusubuuzi iye khukulisa itubaana (combined) ni EFRIS yarusa e-receipts ni e-invoices  nga irambisa Inengekha yaburaawa ilangibwa “Application Programming Interface” (API). inyalisa busubuuzi bwekamani ni “computerized accounting systems” (nga ERP ni POS).
Bibyuma bye kamasanyalaze bibisunda “Electronic Dispenser Controller” (EDC)
Bino byakholebwa burawa khunyalisa bifwo bye Kamafura ni Kumuuya.  EDC iyila buterevu bubakha khu EFD iyayungibwa ne yarusa e-receipts  mumbuka inyene.
